When Do You Need Gas Line Repairs in Olmos Park?

Gas line repairs are essential for maintaining a safe and functional system. Over time, gas lines can deteriorate due to age, environmental factors, or accidental damage. Identifying and addressing potential issues quickly can prevent hazardous situations and costly interruptions to your service.

Common signs that you may need gas line repairs might include odors, noises and high energy bills. Natural gas has the smell of sulfur or rotten eggs added to make it easier to notice a gas leak while hissing noises or whistling sounds can also indicate a leak. Sudden increased gas usage on your monthly bill is a sign that there’s a leak somewhere along the line, even if it’s not inside your home.
